related.title: hypre 多重網格：粗網格修正與收縮因子
related.titleEn: hypre multigrid: coarse correction and contraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付Ax/r/誤差表、停止判準與獨立殘差重算；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Ax/residual/error tables, stopping rules and independent residual checks. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫細網格平滑、限制、粗解、延拓、後平滑；在各層標未知數與邊界；.0016/.0256可重算，實際逐輪q若變動則撤回固定q預測。
related.differenceEn: Draw smoothing, restriction, coarse solve, prolongation, and post-smoothing. Label unknowns and boundaries on every level. Reproduce 0.0016 and 0.0256. Withdraw constant-q predictions if observed contraction changes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相對殘差ρ=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂；CG另需適合的對稱正定問題，不能忽略矩陣條件；合成A=diag(2,4)，b=[2,4]，x=[.9,1]；變更x=[.99,1]；名義式 .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual；變更式 .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
假設每V-cycle使殘差乘q，k輪後r_k=r0q^k；固定q是教學近似而非普遍保證；合成r0=1、q=.2、k4；另一平滑器q=.4，其餘相同；名義式 1*.2**4 = 0.0016 residual norm model；變更式 1*.4**4 = 0.0256 residual norm model。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Relative residual rho=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂; CG also requires suitable symmetric-positive-definite systems. Synthetic A=diag(2, 4), b [2, 4], x [.9, 1] then [.99, 1]. Nominal .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual; changed .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

If each V-cycle multiplies the residual by q, then r_k = r0 q^k. Constant q is a teaching approximation, not a universal guarantee. Synthetic r0 = 1, q = 0.2, and k = 4; compare a smoother with q = 0.4. Nominal 1*.2**4 = 0.0016 residual norm model; changed 1*.4**4 = 0.0256 residual norm model. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HPCG：時間占比與整體加速
related.titleEn: HPCG: phase fractions and whole-program speedup
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付Ax/r/誤差表、停止判準與獨立殘差重算；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver Ax/residual/error tables, stopping rules and independent residual checks. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 以四階段時間條畫出依序執行，標清求解迭代數和驗證條件保持相同；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速。
related.differenceEn: Draw four sequential phases with unchanged solver iteration count and numerical validation conditions. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相對殘差ρ=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂；CG另需適合的對稱正定問題，不能忽略矩陣條件；合成A=diag(2,4)，b=[2,4]，x=[.9,1]；變更x=[.99,1]；名義式 .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual；變更式 .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
固定各階段工作時，總時間是階段和；只加速SpMV不能消除平滑、歸約與其他成本；合成SpMV40、平滑30、歸約20、其他10毫秒；SpMV由40改20；名義式 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration；變更式 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Relative residual rho=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂; CG also requires suitable symmetric-positive-definite systems. Synthetic A=diag(2, 4), b [2, 4], x [.9, 1] then [.99, 1]. Nominal .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual; changed .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

With fixed work, total time sums phase times. Faster SpMV does not eliminate smoothing, reductions, or other costs. Synthetic SpMV = 40, smoothing = 30, reduction = 20, other = 10 milliseconds; change SpMV to 20. Nominal 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration; changed 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
